driver_cost_growth_pct.description: predicted margin contribution attributed to cost growth

driver_delay_hours.description: predicted margin contribution attributed to site delay hours

driver_labour_hours.description: predicted margin contribution attributed to labour hours

driver_variation_count.description: predicted margin contribution attributed to variation signals

fact_class.description: provenance marker distinguishing a model output from an observed fact

feature_values.description: the raw feature inputs the contributions were derived from

financial_period.description: the period the prediction is made for; part of the grain

legal_entity_id.description: the legal entity whose project the prediction belongs to

model_version.description: the fitted model version that produced these values; part of the fact identity

n_training_rows.description: number of project rows the model fitted on

predicted_margin_pct.description: the model's predicted project margin at the scoring cut

project_id.description: the project the prediction is about; the fact's subject anchor

training_as_of.description: the transaction-time cutoff the model trained on
